meta.name: game-world-design
meta.description: Design game experience, systems, and levels. Converge the chosen concept into one GAME_DESIGN defining the player promise, core loop, how the world responds, the systems actually needed, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a fully playable prototype. Use for design the game world, deepen the gameplay and levels, write the game design document. 游戏体验、系统与关卡策划。把选定概念收束为一份 GAME_DESIGN，定义玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈、失败和可完整游玩的原型。用于设计游戏世界、深化玩法和关卡等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏概念收束为可玩原型的设计方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在构思游戏世界、核心循环与关卡体验
copy.tagline_en: Turn a game concept into a playable prototype design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're defining game worlds, core loops, and level experiences

howto.what: 把选定概念收敛为一份GAME_DESIGN：生成design/GAME_DESIGN.md，含玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、系统、关卡节奏、反馈与失败、可游玩原型切片。需提交SOURCE_BIBLE.md、CONCEPT.md、PRODUCT_BRIEF.md。
howto.when: 在你提交SOURCE_BIBLE.md、CONCEPT.md和PRODUCT_BRIEF.md三份必需文件，并提出设计游戏世界、深化玩法与关卡或撰写游戏设计文档的需求时触发。

say.text: 基于我给的CONCEPT.md，把核心循环定义成GAME_DESIGN。
say.note: 输出包含玩家承诺和机制规则的GAME_DESIGN。

say.text: 用'教会→变式→组合→检验→命运回收'节奏设计最小验证切片。
say.note: 关卡拍齐全，检验拍含可测张力目标。

say.text: 按PRODUCT_BRIEF写出社交表现假设、验收条件和非目标。
say.note: 供构建与QA阶段直接消费。

howto.what_en: Converts a chosen concept into one GAME_DESIGN: generates design/GAME_DESIGN.md covering player promise, core loop, world response, necessary systems, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a playable prototype slice. Requires SOURCE_BIBLE.md, CONCEPT.md, PRODUCT_BRIEF.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user submits SOURCE_BIBLE.md, CONCEPT.md, and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md and asks to design game world, deepen gameplay/levels, or write a game design document.

say_en.text: Turn my CONCEPT.md into a GAME_DESIGN defining the core loop.
say_en.note: Outputs a GAME_DESIGN with player promise and mechanics.

say_en.text: Design a minimal playable slice with teach-vary-combine-test-fate beats.
say_en.note: All five beats present; test beat has measurable tension targets.

say_en.text: Write social assumptions, acceptance criteria, and non-goals per PRODUCT_BRIEF.
say_en.note: Consumed by build and QA phases.
